blender.description: Claude Blender connector — analyze and mutate the open .blend scene via Blender's Python API. Used by sim/thermal/ and sim/mechanical/ for the OpenFOAM render pipeline (Antmicro flow).
blender.setup: 1) Claude Desktop > Customize > Connectors > Blender > Add. 2) In Blender 4.2+: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > install official MCP add-on. 3) Each session: open scene, press N, BlenderMCP sidebar > Connect to Claude.

fusion.description: Autodesk Fusion connector — text-to-CAD and parametric edits. Requires active Fusion subscription. Community alternative: ndoo/fusion360-mcp-bridge.
fusion.setup: Claude Desktop > Customize > Connectors > Autodesk Fusion > Add. No add-on install needed; runs through APS.
